status_summary: The CY 2026 outpatient payment final rule, published 2025-11-25 and effective 2026-01-01, finalizes a three-year phase-out of the inpatient-only list, (the end year is not stated in the rule text or the CMS fact sheet as read), and removes 285 services in the first year; it adds 289 procedures to the ASC covered procedures list according to the CMS fact sheet of 2025-11-21 (an earlier reading of the rule text gave 276) plus 271 codes leaving the inpatient-only list, and pays the physician fee schedule equivalent rate for drug administration at excepted off-campus hospital departments, exempting rural sole community hospitals. The CY 2027 proposed rule of 2026-07-07 would remove 637 more services from the list, add 618 ASC codes, and apply the equivalent rate to imaging without contrast at those departments. The stage is implemented because the elimination policy, ASC expansion and site-neutral extension are operative through a final rule, while the list remains in place until the phase-out ends and site-neutral payment so far reaches only selected services.

timeline.event: CY 2026 OPPS/ASC final rule published: inpatient-only list phase-out begins with 285 removals, ASC list additions, and a physician fee schedule equivalent rate for drug administration at excepted off-campus departments.
CY 2027 OPPS/ASC proposed rule published: would remove 637 services from the inpatient-only list, add 618 ASC codes, and apply the equivalent rate to certain imaging codes; comments due 2026-08-31.

title: Phase out the Medicare inpatient-only list and expand ASC and site-neutral payment
uncertainties: Only about the first 100,000 characters of the CY 2027 proposed rule were read; the page text of the CY 2026 final rule was read to its end on 2026-10-23. A full-elimination date of 2029-01-01 for the inpatient-only list appears only in a rule summary by the American Society of Hematology (hematology.org), an unverified lead at low confidence; the final rule text on federalregister.gov, the CMS fact sheet of 2025-11-21 and the CY 2027 proposed rule (first 100,000 characters) state a three-year phase-out beginning with 285 services in CY 2026 but no end year, and (inference) a three-year schedule from CY 2026 would end around the start of 2029; the CMS fact sheet counts 289 procedures added to the ASC covered procedures list, where an earlier reading of the rule text gave 276, and does not say how that count relates to the 271 former inpatient-only codes it also lists as added; whether the full schedule is codified at 42 CFR 419.22 or set out only in preamble tables was not confirmed. Whether the CY 2027 proposals were finalized in the November 2026 cycle is not yet known. No litigation over the drug administration payment change was searched in this review.
